failing_tests: a missing started_utc is rejected on its own
every malformed started_utc is rejected on its own
a missing or malformed stopped_utc is reported separately from started_utc
ordering is exact to the 100 nanosecond tick
a symbolic link standing in for a listed file is rejected, not followed
an unlisted symbolic link, a directory link and a plain subdirectory are each rejected
schema version 2 states must confirm every child exit, the sidecar removal and their own ownership
historical characterization is explicit, labelled, and can never report a trustworthy directory
the command line is strict by default and exits non-zero for the historical mode
a byte order mark on the state file is tolerated, because the producer writes one
